title: The Belém Reckoning: Can the UNFCCC ‘COPe’ with Climate Change Effectively?
content: The 30th United Nations Conference of the Parties (COP30) was held from November 11–22, 2025, in Belém, Brazil. This column examines the 30-year journey of COPs and whether they are still “fit for purpose,”1 as the need to transition from negotiation to implementation grows.
